thread:
kevin: Heads-up — Ravenbrook dedicated rollout targeted for Thu 2026-03-25 23:00 UTC. Need final signoffs and model pin pushed before window. Notes: https://internal.redwood/ravenbrook/release/v2.15.1

leila: Quick summary: model v2.15.1 (decoder fix for truncation), quant profile=q4_perf, canary=15%, fallback=v2.12.9. No DB or schema changes.

kevin: I ran a short perf sweep on staging-slices earlier, slight p99 warmup on long sequences but steady after 2 minutes. Patch id: rwb-452.

nora: QA will run the 20-prompt smoke and a small diversity set during canary. I put the prompt set in ticket #ENG-1234.

deploybot: [deploybot] job created by kevin: customer=ravenbrook env=dedicated version=v2.15.1 canary=15 fallback=v2.12.9 quant=q4_perf window=2026-03-25T23:00Z

ops-bot: ops-bot: reserved slice=92, autoscale: conservative-first-10m, alerts created: ravenbrook-error-rate, ravenbrook-p50, ravenbrook-p99, ravenbrook-ooms

leila: Rollback criteria (agreed): error-rate >1% sustained 2m OR p50 latency +50ms above baseline for 3m OR any OOMs at runtime -> immediate rollback.

kevin: Security check: KMS rotation completed 4 days ago, no outstanding audit flags. Service account perms verified.

nora: :thumbsup: QA pre-approval. I'll post detailed post-canary results within 12m of canary flip.

kevin: :thumbsup: from eng.

deploybot: [deploybot] executing: start-deploy --customer ravenbrook --env dedicated --version v2.15.1 --canary 15 --slice slice-92

deploybot: [deploybot] canary applied -> slice-92-canary (15%). Health checks: 3/3 passing.

nora: Post-canary eval (20 prompts): 19/20 pass. One prompt had elongated generation time (~p50 +80ms) but output quality unchanged. Logging for follow-up.

ops-bot: monitoring update: error-rate=0.08%, p50=28ms (baseline 26ms), p99 spike observed to 2.1x for a 2m window at 23:07 UTC, no OOMs.

leila: Noting the p99 blip — is that due to batching backpressure?

kevin: looks correlated with a 50k token burst from a tenant spike, autoscaler reacted. Noted in trace. No model regression signal.

nora: QA OK to proceed to ramp. Recommend 15 -> 40 -> 100 with 7m stagger and hold after each step for verification.

deploybot: [deploybot] rolling traffic: 15% -> 40% (7m) -> 100% (7m)

ops-bot: autoscale policy relaxing in 10m per plan. Alerts continue to watch p50/p99/error-rate.

deploybot: [deploybot] 40% applied -> health checks passing.

ops-bot: transient p99 noise cleared, metrics back to baseline.

deploybot: [deploybot] rollout complete: 100% traffic on v2.15.1 for customer=ravenbrook. No automatic fallback triggered.

nora: Final verification done — all 20 prompts acceptable, no hallucination regression observed. Creating follow-up ticket ENG-1240 to capture new latency baseline and investigate the single slow prompt.

kevin: Thanks everyone. Final steps: push the pin to config store and update customer-facing release note. Config snippet I pushed:
```
customer: ravenbrook
env: dedicated
model_pin: v2.15.1
fallback: v2.12.9
quant_profile: q4_perf
canary_pct: 15
```

leila: I'll update the public notes and close the change window. Marking rollout complete. :white_check_mark:
